title: fix(i18n,app-shell): pending-drafts bar keys land in the locale packs (#5696 follow-up, main is red)
body:
## What

#5696 shipped `PendingDraftsBar` with root-level `ai.pendingDrafts.*` t() keys that exist in no locale pack — the en call-site key gate and the i18n ratchet test are both red on main (my miss: I ran the component tests but not the key gate before merging). Keys move to `console.ai.pendingDrafts.*` — the surface's real namespace (`console.ai` block) — with **en + zh** entries; other locales fall back to en per the pack's normal behavior.

Verified: `check-i18n-call-site-keys` ratchet + bar tests — 68 passed; `i18n` and `app-shell` tsc builds green.

Fix-forward for main; please expedite.
